title: Moon Landings Faked? Filmmaker Says Not!
summary: A filmmaker explains why the Apollo moon landing footage could not have been faked in a studio, based on the video and film technology of the late 1960s. He walks through the limits of cameras, frame rates and effects of the era.
why: HN points to it as a concise, technically grounded rebuttal to moon-hoax claims.

quote.text: This video goes through why the video technology at the time simply wasn't even good enough to enable faking the moon landing.
